preconditions.description: The first line of input is a positive integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) representing the number of elements in the list a.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 50 for a_i in [int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains n integers a_i (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 50) representing the lengths of the longest common prefixes between consecutive strings.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) <= 200 for s_i in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output string s_i has length between 1 and 200, consisting of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(s_i.islower() and s_i.isalpha() for s_i in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output string s_i consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output contains exactly n + 1 lines, one for each string s_i.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) >= 1 for s_i in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output string s_i has a length of at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) >= a_i for i in range(len(a)) for a_i in a for s_i, s_j in zip([line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive strings s_i and s_{i+1}, the length of the longest common prefix is exactly a_i.

postconditions.expression: all(s_i[:a_i] == s_j[:a_i] for i in range(len(a)) for a_i in a for s_i, s_j in zip([line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive strings s_i and s_{i+1}, the first a_i characters of s_i and s_{i+1} are identical.

postconditions.expression: all(s_i[a_i] != s_j[a_i] if a_i < len(s_i) and a_i < len(s_j) else True for i in range(len(a)) for a_i in a for s_i, s_j in zip([line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive strings s_i and s_{i+1}, if a_i is less than the length of both strings, the (a_i + 1)-th character of s_i and s_{i+1} differ.
